author: Swinhoe, 1863
habitat: 침엽수림, 숲 가장자리, 하층 식물이 빽빽한 숲속
summary: 5월과 10월에 한반도를 지나가는 나그네새로, 침엽수림에 살며 전국에서 관찰된다. 이른 아침에는 숲 가장자리 가까이에서 움직이고, 낮에는 침엽수가 어둡게 우거진 숲속에서 쓰러진 나무 위나 하층 식물이 빽빽한 틈을 걸어 다닌다. 국외에서는 시베리아, 중국, 인도차이나에 분포한다.

points.en: rusty-brown cheeks, ear-coverts and neck sides
off-white underparts with a rusty wash

art.subject: Rufous-tailed Robin (Larvivora sibilans), adult on spring passage (sexes alike): upperparts plain olive-brown; sides of the forehead in front of the eye rusty-buff; cheeks, ear-coverts and neck sides warm rusty-brown; wings brown with olive-brown outer edges; uppertail coverts and tail chestnut-rufous; underparts off-white with a slight rusty wash; throat and breast feathers narrowly fringed olive-brown, giving a fine scaly pattern; flanks olive-grey; thin, pointed dark bill; dark brown eye; pale pinkish legs.
art.pose: walking along a fallen log on the dim forest floor
art.scene: Korean conifer forest interior in May with dense undergrowth and fallen trees; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on a mossy log: olive-brown upperparts, rusty-brown face and neck sides, scaly olive-brown fringes on the off-white throat and breast, olive-grey flanks, chestnut tail, pink legs
adult, front view: off-white throat and breast neatly scaled with olive-brown fringes, rusty-buff sides of the forehead, rusty-brown cheeks
art.build: Small, round-bodied chat, 14cm — about sparrow length but plumper and longer-legged, with a rounded head and short neck. Bill thin and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs fairly long, slender and pale pink. Wings short and rounded. Tail medium-short and square, constantly shivered. Walks and hops on the dim forest floor and along fallen logs, the body held horizontal.
avoid: Do not paint an orange face and breast (Japanese Robin) or blue upperparts (Siberian Blue Robin, Larvivora cyane).
Do not leave the breast plain; the fine olive-brown scaling is its mark.
Do not extend the rufous onto the back or wings; only the uppertail coverts and tail are chestnut.
